title: Backyard Green A-Z
hook: Look and point along with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two short beats for mixed-age retrieval
visualStyle: cozy 3D backyard garden storybook, sunny fence and lawn, colorful planters, simple child-safe scene, crisp foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a small-garden observer noticing growth, color, insects and safe tools
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: memorable two-line thematic reset with child-compatible echo
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 alternates growth images, color, shape, insects and safe garden-object functions; never say every object is growing.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 leaves a recall beat and uses object-specific grow, open, wiggle, pour, point or shape gestures; tools stay safe.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba seed-to-sprout answer figures and tiny shaker breaths
